question: Does the orthogonal union of context-stable static weight-read modes and fit-specific suffix-Jacobian modes form a sufficient, complement-inert component quotient across both task constructions?

frozen_design.static_modes: Exact row spaces of the L9H1/H4 task read map (MLPs) or its contraction through the head output projection (heads).
frozen_design.jacobian_modes: The already-frozen 95%-energy fit-gradient construction, recomputed exactly from original A1 fit rows.
frozen_design.union: QR-orthogonalize the concatenation of each component's static and Jacobian bases; no causal outcome chooses union rank.

predictions.pred_a_authority_replay_capability_proje: Authorities, gradient-forward replay, capability, projectors, coverage, finiteness and exact price pass.
predictions.pred_b_union_modes_are_sufficient: Union recovery is at least 0.95 of full-program recovery and donorward on every task/panel.
predictions.pred_c_union_complements_are_secondary: Absolute union-complement recovery is at most 0.20 of full-program recovery on every task/panel.
predictions.pred_d_union_is_still_dimensionally_comp: Every union rank is below its raw width and no larger than 66 for has/had or 19 for is/was.
predictions.pred_e_no_causal_fit_or_model_update: No heldout/A2 outcome selects modes and no model update occurs.

decision: screen promotes the union quotient to fresh tensor-program validation; null rejects this two-source closure without threshold repair; invalid on authority, replay, capability, projection, coverage, finiteness, or price failure
